summary.text: Tammy Mulchi is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 9, serving since 2024.
The district covers all of Charlotte, Halifax, Lunenburg, Mecklenburg, Nottoway and Pittsylvania counties and Danville City, plus part of Prince Edward County.
The Senate biography lists Tammy Mulchi's occupations as realtor and residential contractor.

paragraphs.text: The biography says Tammy Mulchi was born in South Hill, Virginia.
It lists Liberty University under education.
The biography lists Tammy Mulchi as founder and president of The Windsong Foundation and a member of the Three Rivers Treatment Center board.
Tammy Mulchi serves on the Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; Privileges and Elections; and Transportation committees.
